digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The dashboard shows no tracked tasks completed today, while Teams and Outlook show that Amazon Connect testing continued through regrouped sessions with some access and call-flow issues still unresolved. Tomorrow remains meeting-heavy, with UAT work overlapping other commitments late in the day.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect UAT access and channel blockers
items.detail: Several access issues were cleared today, but Omni-Channel visibility and a Group 2 voicemail and transfer defect still need confirmation before testing can close.

items.label: Secure the dedicated Salesforce integration account
items.detail: Confirm whether the non-human production account will be created directly or routed through Halo, including the required permissions and monitoring.

items.label: Finalize the Amazon Connect training audience and UAT checkpoint
items.detail: Confirm the remaining training audience and capture completion by group, no-show recovery, and confirmed blockers so the team can track progress toward Friday's 80% target.

items.label: Review the Supabase security alert
items.detail: Confirm the affected project and severity, then assign remediation or document why no immediate action is needed.

items.label: Finish the executive updates deck
items.detail: Complete the requested review and add the slide covering EPMO projects completed in August before the leadership discussion.

items.label: Lock the Legal Guidance SOP, training path, and knowledge record
items.detail: Use today's KM and Legal Compliance materials to confirm project overlap, secure the remaining approvals, protect the September 15 Contigo launch, and verify which Enterprise Knowledge Management record is authoritative.

items.label: Reconcile Asana with Armando's spreadsheet
items.detail: Close stale entries and leave one current operating view before this week's portfolio reviews.

items.label: Clarify the Toggl capacity model and escalation path
items.detail: Document how capacity will be measured, who owns missing project IDs, and how the data will inform staffing.

items.label: Decide Sara Rodriguez's Training Agenda access
items.detail: Approve or decline the SharePoint request after confirming that the Client Services training material is appropriate for her role.

items.label: Reply to Thiago's September 17 reschedule request
items.detail: Confirm whether the Thiago 1:1 can move to Thursday, September 17 while next week's Amazon Connect UAT and go-live work are arranged.

items.label: Standalone Amazon Connect Group 2 and Group 4 sessions were cancelled
items.detail: The separate sessions were replaced with combined Group 1 and 2 and Group 3 and 4 working sessions for today's UAT.

items.label: Combine today's Amazon Connect UAT groups
items.detail: The team combined Groups 1 and 2 for one session and Groups 3 and 4 for another, replacing the standalone Group 2 and Group 4 meetings.

items.label: Treat the NTA client notification as Tier 1 work
items.detail: The request was classified as high priority because delayed notice creates client risk, and the team directed it into Sprint 18.

items.label: 10:30 AM-noon - Standup, Armando 1:1, and Amazon Connect sync
items.detail: The SVC standup starts at 10:30 AM, followed by the Armando 1:1 at 11:30 AM; the Amazon Connect weekly sync and Group 2 UAT both begin at noon.

items.label: 12:30-3:15 PM - Protected work, CM CoE, and Group 4 UAT
items.detail: Blocked space runs to 1:30 PM, followed by the CM CoE touchpoint and the Group 4 working session at 2:15 PM.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Weekly meeting conflicts with Group 3 UAT
items.detail: Choose attendance or delegate UAT coverage before both commitments begin.

items.label: 5:00 PM - Group 1 UAT closes the day
items.detail: Keep the test-script results and unresolved blockers ready for the final working session.
